unresolvedPublicationFindings.title: Both build distractors together produce a coherent alternative argument
unresolvedPublicationFindings.evidence: With the unchanged frame and chips 역까지 차로 / 가는 집이 / 역 주차장도, selecting the two supplied distractors 늘면 and 나빠질 거예요. yields “즉, 역까지 차로 가는 집이 늘면 역 주차장도 나빠질 거예요.” More households driving to the station worsening its parking is a coherent conditional argument in support of shared bikes. It uses the same five positions and nine-eojeol focus as the canonical decrease/improvement formulation.

unresolvedPublicationFindings.requestedFix: Before learner publication, redesign at least one distractor or the visible task so the combined alternative is decidable. Review combinations as well as single substitutions. Preserve the coherent canonical recording line.

unresolvedPublicationFindings.title: The savings build tests an unstated quantity of discarded groceries
unresolvedPublicationFindings.evidence: Substituting supplied 봤고 전부 for 봤고 반은 yields “원래 요리를 안 하던 사람이라 장을 많이 봤고 전부 버렸어요. 결과적으로 외식보다 더 썼어요.” This is a grammatical explanation of the failed savings plan. The opener asks whether the plan succeeded; neither it nor the fixed frame establishes that precisely half rather than all the groceries were discarded.
unresolvedPublicationFindings.impact: A learner can give a plausible explanation and be marked wrong for a detail not fixed by the visible task. Canonical spoken content remains sound.
unresolvedPublicationFindings.requestedFix: Before publication, replace the quantity-only distractor or introduce an appropriate visible fact/cue. A hidden translation is not that cue. This is a newly documented exercise hold, not a request for another broad canonical review.

priorFindingResolutions.title: The reverted fee statement loses the Korean scene-specific attribution required by the authority
priorFindingResolutions.evidence: Final P1L6 says “정리하면, 수수료는 매출의 삼 퍼센트 정도예요.” Only the de/en situation identifies a fictional offer. V2 semanticReviewRules[6] requires fictional fees/policies to be locally attributed in the Korean line. Fable edit 20 deliberately removed 제안대로면 because no proposal had been introduced in Korean; the old phrase should therefore not simply be restored.
priorFindingResolutions.impact: The spoken line now sounds like an unqualified statement of the app fee, and the final source conflicts with the explicit authority. A canonical spoken repair or an explicit authority arbitration is required before freezing these recording inputs.
priorFindingResolutions.requestedFix: Fable should supply a natural in-range Korean attribution with a genuine referent, adjusting the earlier Korean scene if needed, and update all coupled fields; alternatively adjudicate this precise authority conflict explicitly. Retain the trial condition and avoid an earnings guarantee.
priorFindingResolutions.resolution: RESOLVED: 제가 알아본 앱은 supplies an actual Korean referent for the three-percent fee. Sixteen eojeol; one-month trial and increase condition retained. Both bases, example, synthesis and speech tokens coupled.

priorFindingResolutions.title: The shared-bike argument needs a stated link between leaving cars unused and better parking
priorFindingResolutions.evidence: P2L9 concludes “즉, 아침에 차 안 쓰는 집이 늘면 주차도 나아질 거예요.” The scene concerns the apartment complex’s shared-bike proposal. The stated facts are only a fifteen-minute walk versus a five-minute ride to the station. Cars being left unused does not by itself explain reduced parking demand at the complex; parking at the station could improve, but that location is not stated.
priorFindingResolutions.impact: The restatement introduced by 즉 contains an ambiguous causal inference in an argument lesson. This is a request to clarify the intended parking location/mechanism, not a claim that cycling can never improve parking.
priorFindingResolutions.requestedFix: Fable should clarify the relevant parking location or provide the missing causal bridge, or conclude with a benefit established by the preceding comparison. Keep the supportive stance, whole trophy 즉, turn bounds and coupled exercises/variants intact.
priorFindingResolutions.resolution: RESOLVED: 역까지 차로 가는 집이 줄면 역 주차장도 explicitly names mechanism and location. Twenty-eojeol first reply, nine-eojeol focus; all bases/build/recall/example/trophy/term/speech/variant fields coupled.

priorFindingResolutions.title: A build distractor already occurs in the fixed first reply
priorFindingResolutions.evidence: P1L9 includes 맞아요. as a distractor, while the fixed prefix is “제 생각에는 따라가는 게 맞아요.” The actual native gate rejects this as DISTRACTOR_PRESENT.
priorFindingResolutions.impact: The whole-line distractor absence contract fails. This is a content defect, not a reason to relax the validator.
priorFindingResolutions.requestedFix: Replace this distractor with a grammatical, contextually wrong and whole-eojeol-absent option; independently review the replacement in the actual build focus.
priorFindingResolutions.resolution: RESOLVED: 맞아요. removed from P1L9 distractors; replacements are whole-eojeol-absent.

priorFindingResolutions.title: The new fixed-choice set still admits a natural concessive answer
priorFindingResolutions.evidence: P1L9 permits only 걱정이라서, but supplied 걱정이지만 gives “저도 그게 걱정이지만 삼월 새 학기에 맞춰 가려고요. 아이한테는 이미 설명했고, 새 학교도 같이 가 봤어요.” This acknowledges the worry and continues with a plan despite it, a coherent answer to the child-transfer objection. No visible form cue forces a cause ending.
priorFindingResolutions.impact: A native, contextually suitable response is one of the rejected choices.
priorFindingResolutions.requestedFix: Replace the concessive distractor with an option genuinely incompatible with the displayed context, or provide an explicit visible form constraint consistent with the exercise contract. Also adjudicate P2L9 신고하니까 versus 신고하면 in the stated proposal procedure: the causal habitual reading remains plausible, so the new set should not be assumed unique merely from the intended conditional carrier.
priorFindingResolutions.resolution: RESOLVED for original choices: 걱정이지만/걱정이라도 and 신고하니까 removed; replacements read against full displayed sentences and prompts.

priorFindingResolutions.title: An accepted synonym changes the exact points threshold
priorFindingResolutions.evidence: P2L4 consistently specifies 만 점이 넘으면 in you1 and you3, translated as above/über ten thousand. Fable edit 54 adds 되면, which makes 만 점이 되면 and includes reaching exactly ten thousand instead of exceeding it.
priorFindingResolutions.impact: The acceptance list certifies a different fictional policy from the one taught in the canonical dialogue.
priorFindingResolutions.requestedFix: Remove the non-equivalent acceptance row, or have Fable explicitly revise the threshold and every coupled Korean/base field consistently. Do not treat > and >= as interchangeable.
priorFindingResolutions.resolution: RESOLVED: 되면 removed; 넘으면/넘어가면 preserve the strictly-above threshold.

priorFindingResolutions.title: The added 재 봤더니 answer makes a recognition-only family learner-productive
priorFindingResolutions.evidence: Fable edit 56 adds 재 봤더니 at P2L5. B1 P1L9-10 reserves -더니 for recognition, B1 P8 keeps -더라고요 recognition-only, and B2 P2L1-3 explicitly puts -았/었더니 in them turns. No later B2 P2 productive range promotes that family. The canonical answer 재 보면 is properly staged.
priorFindingResolutions.impact: The new accepted input row crosses the declared learner grammar progression. It also changes a conditional measurement instruction into a past observation and should not be labeled an unqualified equivalent without review.
priorFindingResolutions.requestedFix: Remove that acceptance row or have Fable explicitly authorize and stage this family; do not silently broaden the production gate based on an added synonym.
priorFindingResolutions.resolution: RESOLVED: 재 봤더니 removed; retained measurement alternatives do not introduce the recognition-only past-observation family.
